summary: Nez Perce NF L-4 cab on a 20-foot tower, built 1934 about 10 miles NE of Moose Creek; destroyed about 1951; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed about 1951 per Forest Lookouts and other pages; no source describes the site now

notes_for_editor: History is corroborated by four sources: 1934 build, about 1951 destruction, and the 1957 transfer from Bitterroot to Nez Perce. Nothing found on the site today. Location conflict from the brief is unresolved and not checked: FFLA gives 46.23544, -114.80378 and West US Lookouts gives 46.2442, -114.8044; the Nez Perce list places it at T33N R13E Sect. 2, which matches the Forest Lookouts page (33N-13E-2). No access level is given because no source describes access. The Forest Lookouts page carries a bare 'Removed' label with no date; not used. No usable photo URL found. The list writes Ranger Station as RS; the story expands that abbreviation.
